title: Adaptive SLI composition and retention policy for high-cardinality analytics events
creator: Aisha Patel
description: We need a robust approach to compose SLIs for the analytics ingestion and console backend that balances accuracy and cost for high-cardinality event streams. The goal is an adaptive SLI composition pipeline that: 1) builds composite SLIs from sampled traces, logs, and aggregated metrics; 2) provides configurable retention levels (full, sampled, rollup) that support retroactive SLO backfills; and 3) enforces budgeted tracing and event retention to keep observability costs predictable for tenants. This ticket scopes the design and initial implementation for the pipeline, dashboard templates, and runbook updates.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc reviewed and approved by Observability and Analytics owners
Prototype pipeline emits composed SLIs (availability, p95 latency, error-rate) using sampled traces + aggregated counters
Retention tiers implemented: 90d full-raw (opt-in), 30d sampled traces (1-5%), 365d rollup metrics (hourly aggregates)
Backfill tool can recompute SLIs for a 30-day window using retained rollups and sampled traces
Budgeted tracing enforced: no workload can exceed 15% of trace ingestion budget without explicit approval
Dashboard template created with per-tenant SLI trends, sampling rate, and cost attribution, and linked in the Console
Runbook entry for investigating SLI regressions with trace/linking steps and escalation contacts
tasks: Write design doc: composition model, data inputs, retention tiers, cost model
Add sampling knobs to ingest pipeline and expose per-tenant sampling rate in telemetry
Implement rollup job for hourly aggregates with tags required for SLI recomputation
Build 'SLI composer' service to merge sampled traces and rollups into SLI time series
Add per-tenant budget checks and rate-limited trace exporter
Create Grafana/Console dashboard template and embed in Console observability section
Author runbook and link to incident playbooks for SLO breaches
